title: Chapter 404 Wushang Disciples
content:
Chapter 404 Wushang Disciples

As a senior figure in the Wu family, how could she not know the name of the first emperor of the Human Emperor Palace?

No wonder she thought Lu Xue was so familiar when she came.

Although she had some guesses in her heart, she couldn't help but feel shocked when she heard the name Lu Xue.

The first palace master is actually back!

At this moment, the memories of youth began to emerge from her mind.

At that time, she was just an ordinary talented girl in the Wu family and was not prominent in the Wu family.

It was also at that time that Lu Xue emerged from nowhere and founded the Human Emperor Hall, leading the human race in the Chaos Realm to a brilliant road.

From that time on, the name Lu Xue of the Human Emperor Palace was deeply imprinted in her mind and she would never forget it for her whole life.

But now, the existence that could only be looked up to back then was standing in front of her alive.

She was both excited and frightened.

Her Wu family dared to have conflicts with this person, and Wu Hua was really brave.

Alas, I should have come early.

Wu Zhi sighed in his heart and regretted it.

"Haha, the Wu family has a great career, and they will still remember me."

Looking at Wu Zhi who was kneeling on one knee in front of him and was afraid to come out of his temper, Lu Xue couldn't help but speak sarcastically.

This sentence made Wu Zhi tremble all over and his pretty face lowered deeply, "This is the fault of the Wu family, and the Wu family is willing to bear any punishment."

"Wrong? Then tell me, where is your Wu family wrong?"

Lu Xue continued to speak, as if she was a little aggressive.

Hearing this, Wu Zhi looked a little ugly and became stuttering, "Yes, it's because he offended you."

Lu Xue shook her head.

"Because Wu Hua is arrogant and insulting you?"

Lu Xue still shook her head.

Wu Zhi was silent. When she first came, Wu Hua was already dead. These were just her guesses.

Could it be that Wu Hua did something that made Lu Xue angry that implicated the Wu family?

Thinking of this, Wu Zhi was angry and wanted to revive Wu Hua and let her kill him again.

Even if Wu Hua is a genius in the main vein, she dares to do so.

And the Wu family definitely dare not say anything.

After all, geniuses are just geniuses. They will never be as good as a ready-made strong man without growing up.

At this time, Lu Xue sighed in disappointment.

This is true for the Wu family, and I'm afraid most of the top leaders of the human race are like this now.

Power makes them swell.

This seems inevitable.

Dad, what would you do if you were there?

Lu Xue looked up at the sky. At this moment, her longing for Lu Daosheng gushed out like a spring.

Dad, where have you been wandering again?

I don’t know if I don’t bring me a younger brother and sister back one day.

"Wu Zhi."

"exist."

"Go back."

Lu Xue skipped over Wuzhi and continued to walk forward, with the old man Broken Sword following closely behind.

When he was still there, Wu Zhi was still kneeling in the same place, and Lu Xue had already left.

After being silent for a long time, Wu Zhi slowly stood up. At this moment, there was a sense of anger in her heart. At this time, Wu Tianxiong, who was blown away by her, finally woke up.

"Wu, Lord Wuzhi, why are you?"

Wu Tianxiong covered his face with one hand and walked towards Wu Zhi swayingly, with a grievance and confusion on his face.

Seeing that Wu Tianxiong dared to come over, Wu Zhi snorted coldly, kicked Wu Tianxiong away with one kick, and then left here along the space teleportation channel.

As Wu Zhi left, the space transmission channel was also closed.

Wu Tianxiong was completely confused.

"My master, why don't you just call that guy Wu Shang back and let him handle his own family affairs by himself, so it will save you more trouble."

Ao Qing lay lazily on Lu Xuexiang's shoulders, yawning while saying.

This is not bad, and it is indeed very convenient.

But Lu Xue refused.

"It's still a bit early to let him come back. Let's talk about it until the matter is done."

"Ao."

The two of them continued walking, not knowing when they were about to go.

.........

"What did you say?! The first palace master!!!"

In the Human Imperial City, a scream suddenly came from a terrifying family.

In the main hall of the house, Wu Zhi lowered his head slightly.

In the main seat of the hall, a middle-aged man with a strong body and a tough face suddenly stood up. He heard the news that Wu Zhi brought back and couldn't help but scream.

The first palace master, Lu Xue, is back.

This surprised him how he was not surprised.

Huh huh huh huh.

At this time, the door was suddenly broken, and then several senior officials of the Wu family broke in.

"What's wrong with the head of the family?"

"What happened?"

"Hmm? Wu Zhi, why are you here? Didn't you go to save Hua'er?"

Everyone looked different and they immediately felt the strange atmosphere in the hall.

Wu Zhi glanced at the head of the Wu family. With the approval gaze, Wu Zhi turned around and said lightly to everyone: "Two things, one is Wu Hua dead, and the other is the first palace master back."

As soon as these words came out, the originally noisy master's hall suddenly fell into ghostly silence.

Wu Zhi's words were so informative that everyone present was confused.

Wu Hua is dead.

That is a genius from the main lineage of the family. Which genius is not a carefully cared for.

But at this moment, everyone did not have much fluctuations about Wu Hua's death, because the second thing was even more explosive.

The first palace master is back!

Lu Xue, the existence who established the Human Emperor Palace and destroyed the gods.

Of course, as the top human forces, their Wu family naturally knew some of the truth about that year.

The gods were not destroyed by Lu Xue.

The one who truly destroyed the gods was Lu Xue's father, and the owner of the supreme city that is still floating above the human race is Lu Xue's father.

Such a terrifying identity and status made all living beings in the Chaos Realm able to look up.

And now, such a person is back.

In other words, the current chaos realm pattern seems to be about to change again.

The Wu family's current status among the human race is definitely the top, and all of this is achieved through the efforts of the ancestors of the Wu family.

The first emperor of the palace abdicated the position of the palace master to their ancestors of the Wu family, Wu Shang. After painstaking management, Wu Shang integrated the entire scattered Human Emperor Hall into a solid fortress.

The system is strict and rewards and punishments are clear.

Then Wu Shang also left. Before leaving, Wu Shang entrusted the Renhuang Palace to his disciples.

That was an abandoned son he adopted in the Chaos Realm. After careful cultivation by Wushang, he gradually grew into a stubborn person.

Wushang did not misread people. Although Wushang's disciples did not make the De Renhuang Palace go to a higher level overall, they still made the De Renhuang Palace develop steadily over the years.

Wu Shang and his disciples are both masters and apprentices, and they are like father and son.

Therefore, under the influence of Wushang, the contemporary Renhuang Palace is very caring for the Wushang family.

This is also one of the reasons why the Wu family has become so arrogant now.

"Come, bring this news to the Lord of the Palace and let him come to see me."

The head of the Wu family rubbed his head and ordered the people below. Then he shook his hand and left the place, leaving only the people in the master's hall stunned.
